fields.executive_summary:
- Workstation takes any person's challenge and, with its own AI, either helps them do the work themselves or builds them a living enterprise that delivers the solution and then runs itself [owner-defined: the vision, sections 1 and 3A].
- It exists to give everyone the capability that only the largest organisations have had [owner-defined: the vision, section 14].
- Today it runs on the Owner's machine, with a local model, in virtual money, with sign-in off, and with no users but the Owner and no income [observed].
- The Owner works on it full time and prefers to start without cost [owner-defined, 2026-10-13].
fields.concept:
- **Domain Working**: tools for a person's own work across six domains - Religion, Science, Education, Law, Employment and Career, and Care. The first people it is offered to are those using the Law, Employment and Career, and Education tools [owner-defined: the vision, section 3A; ruling of 2026-10-10].
- **The Quran Education Platform** is the Religion domain's flagship and stays free [owner-defined: the vision, appendix A; ruling of 2026-10-10].
- **Concept to commercialisation**: one idea taken end to end into a living enterprise, with a board, a plan, books and a record of every change [owner-defined: the vision, section 4; observed in `agentic_core/api/change_control.py`].
- **Each enterprise is an economic organism**: it pays the platform 25% of its profit first, for updates and maintenance, and from what remains it pays its own owner 20 parts in a hundred, reinvests in itself and gives to causes, in virtual money until the Owner directs real rails [owner-defined: the vision, section 12; ruling of 2026-10-12; amended by the Owner on 2026-11-22]. Before 2026-11-22 this read: "it pays its owner a share, reinvests in itself and gives to causes, in virtual money until the Owner directs real rails."
fields.vision: - A living, AI-mediated platform that takes any person's challenge, in any realm or domain of life and work, designs the best solution, and establishes a living enterprise that delivers it and then runs, defends, heals, learns and grows itself in faithful service of the founder's intent, ethically, compliantly and for the benefit of all humanity [owner-defined: the vision, section 1, shortened here].
fields.mission:
- Democratise working, AI-mediate human work so it is safer and easier, and resolve the challenges people face in every domain, with ethics that bind the design: integrity, compassion, excellence, halal compliance, stewardship and beneficence [owner-defined: the vision, section 2].
- The Owner has also stated a personal intention for this work. By the Owner's decision of 2026-10-13 it is held privately and is not published here [owner-defined].
fields.strategy:
The vision measures "available to all" by which switches the Owner has turned. They are turned in this order, each only by the Owner [owner-defined: the vision, section 14; the order ruled 2026-10-12]:
1. Readiness on the Owner's machine: the register closed down and the final audit run [plan item P3.30].
2. Sign-in on [plan item P4.1].
3. A private deploy on one free small machine [plan item P4.5].
4. Invited adults, then self-serve sign-up [plan item P4.2].
5. Outside models, as accelerants only [plan item P4.3].
6. Real money, last, after review [plan item P4.6].
A managed database is left for later [deferred; plan item P4.4].

aims: One person's whole journey, from a challenge to an operating enterprise, driven and measured [plan item P5.1].
The Owner's own first endeavour walked by hand before anyone else's [owner-defined, 2026-10-12].
The Quran platform's memorisation area usable by one invited adult [plan item P5.17].
A person always able to see what waits on them and why [plan item P5.14].
The enterprise's own agreements and its physical assets kept as truthful records [plan item P5.18] [plan item P5.19].

fields.executive_summary:
- Workstation takes any person's challenge and, with its own AI, either helps them do the work themselves or builds them a living enterprise that delivers the solution and then runs itself [owner-defined: the vision, sections 1 and 3A].
- It exists to give everyone the capability that only the largest organisations have had [owner-defined: the vision, section 14].
- Today it runs on the Owner's machine, with a local model, in virtual money, with sign-in off, and with no users but the Owner and no income [observed].
- The Owner works on it full time and prefers to start without cost [owner-defined, 2026-10-13].
fields.concept:
- **Domain Working**: tools for a person's own work across six domains - Religion, Science, Education, Law, Employment and Career, and Care. The first people it is offered to are those using the Law, Employment and Career, and Education tools [owner-defined: the vision, section 3A; ruling of 2026-10-10].
- **The Quran Education Platform** is the Religion domain's flagship and stays free [owner-defined: the vision, appendix A; ruling of 2026-10-10].
- **Concept to commercialisation**: one idea taken end to end into a living enterprise, with a board, a plan, books and a record of every change [owner-defined: the vision, section 4; observed in `agentic_core/api/change_control.py`].
- **Each enterprise is an economic organism**: it pays the platform 25% of its profit first, for updates and maintenance, and from what remains it pays its own owner 20 parts in a hundred, reinvests in itself and gives to causes, in virtual money until the Owner directs real rails [owner-defined: the vision, section 12; ruling of 2026-10-12; amended by the Owner on 2026-11-22]. Before 2026-11-22 this read: "it pays its owner a share, reinvests in itself and gives to causes, in virtual money until the Owner directs real rails."
fields.vision: - A living, AI-mediated platform that takes any person's challenge, in any realm or domain of life and work, designs the best solution, and establishes a living enterprise that delivers it and then runs, defends, heals, learns and grows itself in faithful service of the founder's intent, ethically, compliantly and for the benefit of all humanity [owner-defined: the vision, section 1, shortened here].
fields.mission:
- Democratise working, AI-mediate human work so it is safer and easier, and resolve the challenges people face in every domain, with ethics that bind the design: integrity, compassion, excellence, halal compliance, stewardship and beneficence [owner-defined: the vision, section 2].
- The Owner has also stated a personal intention for this work. By the Owner's decision of 2026-10-13 it is held privately and is not published here [owner-defined].
fields.strategy:
The vision measures "available to all" by which switches the Owner has turned. They are turned in this order, each only by the Owner [owner-defined: the vision, section 14; the order ruled 2026-10-12]:
1. Readiness on the Owner's machine: the register closed down and the final audit run [plan item P3.30].
2. Sign-in on [plan item P4.1].
3. A private deploy on one free small machine [plan item P4.5].
4. Invited adults, then self-serve sign-up [plan item P4.2].
5. Outside models, as accelerants only [plan item P4.3].
6. Real money, last, after review [plan item P4.6].
A managed database is left for later [deferred; plan item P4.4].

aims: One person's whole journey, from a challenge to an operating enterprise, driven and measured [plan item P5.1].
The Owner's own first endeavour walked by hand before anyone else's [owner-defined, 2026-10-12].
The Quran platform's memorisation area usable by one invited adult [plan item P5.17].
A person always able to see what waits on them and why [plan item P5.14].
The enterprise's own agreements and its physical assets kept as truthful records [plan item P5.18] [plan item P5.19].
